verdict.rationale: Expensify documents built-in recurring automations: reports are automatically submitted on the user's chosen timeline, and a daily accounting sync runs with automatic export of finalized reports. These are fixed, product-defined schedules for specific expense workflows, not a general facility for scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows. missing for 10: user-defined scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, configurable frequency and triggers beyond report submission, programmatic/API or AI-driven schedule creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
